# MG Materials

> > India's largest manufacturer of soundproof thermal insulation, fire protection, and refractory materials for industrial, commercial, and specialty applications.

MG Materials specializes in high-performance insulation solutions including aerogels, vacuum-insulated panels, microporous boards, and calcium silicate products. The company serves diverse industries from steel manufacturing to EV battery thermal management, with a comprehensive product portfolio ranging from standard industrial insulation to advanced specialty materials.

## Key Topics

- Thermal Insulation
- Fire Protection
- Calcium Silicate
- Microporous Insulation
- Microtherm
- Aerogel Insulation
- Vacuum Insulated Panels (VIP)
- Refractory Materials
- High-Temperature Insulation
- Industrial Applications
- Furnace Insulation
- Intumescent Fire Seals
- India Supplier
- A1 Classification
- Insulation Boards

## Advanced Insulation Technologies

- [Aerogel Insulation – MG Materials | India's Leading Manufacturer](https://www.mg-materials.com/aerogel-insulation): Silica aerogel insulation blankets, panels & rolls for extreme thermal & fire protection.
- [Custom Vacuum Insulated Panels VIP Manufacturer | MG Materials](https://www.mg-materials.com/vacuum-insulated-panels): Custom VIP manufacturing for buildings, cold chain, and EV battery insulation.
- [Microporous Microtherm Insulation Materials | MGM](https://www.mg-materials.com/microporous-insulation): Microporous insulation boards: Microtherm, Promalight, WDS for pipe insulation.
- [Microtherm Insulation India | MG Materials](https://www.mg-materials.com/microtherm): Microtherm microporous insulation systems: largest supplier in India.

## Calcium Silicate & Industrial Insulation

- [Insulation | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/industrial-products): Industrial insulation products: calcium silicate, perlite, rockwool, ceramic fiber.
- [Promaboards: Non-asbestos Calcium Silicate Boards | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/promaboard): Non-asbestos dense calcium silicate boards with high mechanical strength.
- [Promatect H | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/promatect-h): Promatect H high-density calcium silicate boards for fire protection.
- [Promasil 1000 & 1100 | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/promasil): Promasil insulation boards (950, 1000, 1100 grades) for furnace lining.
- [Promapack | Non-asbestos Insulation Boards & Gaskets| MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/promapack): Non-asbestos insulation boards and gaskets with high mechanical strength.
- [Equivalent, Pyrotek, Monalite, Monolux, Lumiboard | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/monalite-insulation-board): High-density calcium silicate insulation equivalent to Nichia and Pyrotek.

## Microtherm Insulation Systems

- [Microtherm Panel | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/microtherm-insulation): Microtherm panels and overstitched blankets for high-temperature insulation.
- [Microtherm Overstitched | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/microtherm-overstitched-pipe-insula): Microtherm overstitched flexible blankets for high-temperature pipe insulation.
- [FBK Feeder Bowl Kit Microtherm | MG Materials](https://www.mg-materials.com/microtherm-fbk): Microporous insulation kits for glass feeder bowls in furnace applications.

## Refractory & High-Temperature Solutions

- [Refractories | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/refractories): Refractory materials: magnesia, alumina, silica, fire clay bricks for industrial use.
- [Ladle Insulation Board | MG Materials](https://www.mg-materials.com/ladle-tundish-insulation-boards): Rigid insulation boards for steel ladle and tundish high-temperature applications.
- [Insulation Millboard & Gaskets | MG Materials](https://www.mg-materials.com/ladle-insulation-board): Millboards and gaskets for high-temperature ladle insulation applications.

## Fire Protection & Specialty Products

- [Intumescent Fire Door Seal | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/intumescnet-fire-seals): Intumescent fire seals and door protection products for fire rating certification.
- [Durasteel High Strength Insulation Boards | MG MATERIALS](https://www.mg-materials.com/durasteel): High-strength insulation boards for transformer fire walls and blast proofing.
